verdict.rationale: Render's official CLI is documented (render-docs-14, render-probe-4) and a REST API exists (render-docs-15), suggesting some command-line control, but the evidence never explicitly confirms that a full deploy (triggering builds/releases) can be done purely via CLI without ever touching the dashboard. missing for 10: explicit CLI deploy command examples, confirmation that dashboard is not required at any step, independent user reports of CLI-only deploy workflows.
